summary: Iter111 — dependency-only change (watchfiles 1.1.1 → 1.0.5). Verified pin, PyPI availability of cp311 manylinux wheel, requires_python >=3.9, hot reload still functions, all regression endpoints healthy, retailer login (via /api/retailer-auth/login with GSTIN) returns 200 with token, FSM /api/external/v1/ping returns 200, and iter108 + iter110 pytest suites pass (32 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed).

verifications.watchfiles_pin_in_requirements: watchfiles==1.0.5 at line 147 of /app/backend/requirements.txt (confirmed via grep)
verifications.watchfiles_pypi_availability: pip index shows 1.0.5 available; `pip download watchfiles==1.0.5 --python-version 311 --only-binary=:all: --platform manylinux2014_x86_64` succeeded → watchfiles-1.0.5-cp311-cp311-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl (454 kB) prebuilt wheel present. importlib.metadata reports Requires-Python: >=3.9. Compatible with render.yaml pythonVersion 3.11.6.
verifications.no_direct_watchfiles_imports: grep -rn 'import watchfiles' /app/backend/*.py returned 0 hits — only consumed by uvicorn --reload watcher.
verifications.hot_reload_functional: Touched /app/backend/server.py (append+remove blank line) — /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log shows 'WatchFiles detected changes in server.py. Reloading...' + 'Started reloader process ... using WatchFiles'. No ImportError/ModuleNotFoundError in log.
verifications.py311_full_scan: All 150 pinned packages resolved and installed cleanly in the running /root/.venv (Python 3.11) — dry-run reports every requirement already satisfied. abi3/py3-none wheels for bcrypt/playwright confirmed 3.11-compatible. No other Py3.11 blockers.
verifications.note_on_login_path: Retailer login is at /api/retailer-auth/login (not /api/auth/login — the latter returns 422/401). Body requires {gstin, password}. Per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

pytest_results.iter110_waitlist_email_notifications_per: confirmed intact (all TestSpoofingRegressionInProcess + persistence tests pass)

critical_code_review_comments: Pydantic V1 @validator and FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') are deprecated — 70 DeprecationWarnings emitted per test run. Non-blocking but should be migrated to @field_validator and lifespan handlers before Pydantic V3 / FastAPI removes them.

requirements.txt is fully pinned (150 lines) with zero direct import of watchfiles — swap was safe. Consider constraining watchfiles more loosely (>=1.0.5,<2) in future to avoid mirror-lag deploy failures.
test_credentials: Retailer GSTIN 07AAAAA0000A1Z5 / Test@12345 via /api/retailer-auth/login; FSM X-API-Key from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — both working.
seed_data_creation: None. SEED_TEST_B2B_RETAILER already seeded the retailer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dependency swap verified end-to-end. watchfiles==1.0.5 pinned, cp311 manylinux wheel present on PyPI, hot reload works, all regression suites green. Note for future testers: retailer login endpoint is /api/retailer-auth/login (not /api/auth/login) with body {gstin, password}.
